payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) melts before the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS) due to specific geological processes, such as continental levering and ocean syphoning, which contribute to early sea level rise.

claims.text: The Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) melts first, contributing to an early peak in sea level rise before the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS) begins to melt.
The melting of the GrIS is driven by geological processes like continental levering and ocean syphoning, which are significant factors in the timing of ice sheet melting.
